# costgraph_aws_integration (Resource)

Connect an existing AWS FOCUS billing export through an IAM role. CostGraph verifies export access before it saves the connection.

## Before you apply

Prepare a CostGraph tenant, an AWS FOCUS billing export in S3, and an IAM role
that can read the export. Create the AWS resources separately, or manage them
with the AWS provider.

Configure the role's trust policy with your deployment's trusted principal and
your organization's external ID. The [AWS integration guide](https://docs.costgraph.ai/costgraph/integrations/aws)
describes that setup.

Use a user API key owned by an active organization owner. Grant it
`organization:manage` explicitly and supply it through `COSTGRAPH_API_KEY`
or the provider's `api_key` setting.

## Connect the export

The following example connects an existing export and leaves AWS cost allocation
tag activation unchanged.

```terraform
resource "costgraph_aws_integration" "production" {
  tenant_id                     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  billing_account_id            = "123456789012"
  display_name                  = "Production AWS"
  region                        = "us-east-2"
  bucket                        = "example-focus-export"
  prefix                        = "billing/FOCUS/"
  role_arn                      = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CostGraphRead"
  activate_cost_allocation_tags = false
}
```

A successful apply stores the connection in CostGraph and returns its UUID as `id`.

## Update the connection

Changing `tenant_id` or `billing_account_id` replaces the connection. Other
settings update in place and preserve its UUID.

To clear a stored S3 prefix, set `prefix = ""`.

## Disconnect the account

Destroying this resource stops collection and removes the account's billing
data from CostGraph cost views. It also removes automation access stored for
the connection.

Your AWS export, S3 bucket, and IAM role remain in AWS.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account_id` (String) Billing account whose export CostGraph reads. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket containing the existing FOCUS billing export.
- `region` (String) AWS region containing the billing export bucket.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role CostGraph assumes to read the export. Configure its trust policy before applying. This resource supports IAM role assumption only.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase UUID of the tenant that receives the billing data. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `activate_cost_allocation_tags` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to activate discovered AWS cost allocation tags. Defaults to true. Set false when the read role must not change tag activation.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to the billing account identifier. Omitting it after creation preserves the existing name.
- `enable_recommendations` (Boolean) Allow CostGraph to collect the provider's savings recommendations. Defaults to true. The cloud identity needs the corresponding read permissions.
- `prefix` (String) S3 prefix for the export. Defaults to an empty string on creation. Omit it during updates to keep the stored value. Set an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier. Use id for import.
- `external_id` (String) Your organization's external ID, returned after connection creation. Obtain it from CostGraph setup before configuring the IAM trust policy.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.

## Import an existing connection

Import a connection that uses IAM role assumption with its CostGraph UUID.
Use `id`, rather than its AWS account ID or `fpc_` ingestion identifier.

```shell
terraform import costgraph_aws_integration.production 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002
```

Match the resource block to the imported settings before applying changes.
